projects.status_signal: ON-TRACK per 10/14 status email; RAC enablement at risk of slipping because of a newly found backup-VLAN gap

notes.text: Calvin Cochran: Rubrik doing fine; log-deletion issue still needs confirmation. Starting the ~16h RAC initial backup on a weekday was rejected because it could interfere with the production backup (Mike Massimino and Karl Witt: low tolerance for production risk). Plan: kick off Friday night, then a few days of dual running next week, then ship readiness. Karl: Manchester space should be ready before arrival. (Source: Igor's notes-to-self summary of the standup Rubrik segment.)

Igor posted the timeline: 4 successful Pure backups so far (2-3 more ideal). 10/16 IOSP-1014 confirm Pure backup healthy (Calvin); 10/16 18:00 UTC IOSP-1012 enable RAC instance backup (Earle); 10/17-10/20 IOSP-880 run/validate RAC backup; from 10/20 IOSP-1013 prepare appliances for shutdown/Manchester incl. network/IP (Sri, Calvin); 10/27-11/9 IOSP-1015 international shipment (logistics).
Karl Witt: a company is being contracted to pack and ship the gear and will provide anything needing signature.
IOSP-1011 and IOSP-1014 (Pure-based backup) considered complete: ran several days without issues (Earle Long, Calvin Cochran).

Shipment: Calvin pinged Karl again on contract status; contract signed by procurement is the gating item and the ship date (27th) will not be moved up until then. Work is done by Tech X, resold via MicroAge (approved vendor). Appliance prep (new IP per node, shut down; about a dozen nodes) is a couple of hours; Igor set IOSP-1013 to 10/21. Two Sectigo people needed on site at the cage (Calvin arranging with Olu and Jamie).
Earle Long: standby now running in Manchester and catching up; Oracle DBA background work (IOSP-1009) may start earlier than November, possibly end of next week (around 10/23).
Calvin: IOSP-880 validation must also confirm replication to Manchester, since that is fundamental to shutting down and shipping.

Network gap: SCDPCARAC1/2 have no interface on the CA Backup VLAN 130 (Rubrik is configured for VLAN 130 and 2988 only); the IPs Prajeet shared are RAC interconnect/VIPs on other VLANs. Agreed that backup traffic should have its own VLAN. Calvin/Earle: the change needs an RM ticket and must be done in the maintenance window (Sunday 7 PM Eastern; two SREs, Tier 2 Ramana Chowdary), so the Rubrik RAC initial backup moves from Friday to after the window, tentatively 13:00 UTC Sunday 10/18, overlapping briefly with Monday morning production RMAN.
Rubrik/Oracle question: how Rubrik should reach RAC (second VIP on the backup VLAN vs SCAN vs per-node addresses). Calvin will not create tickets until Oracle and Rubrik support answer.

Calvin summarised 5 options (preferred: second VIP on backup VLAN, Prajeet to research; then per-host backup-VLAN addresses with Rubrik detecting live host, Sri to research; Option 3 manual cutover is MVP; Option 4 back up both hosts; Option 5 direct into CA environment, security concern). Under Option 3 RM tickets would be raised and VLAN sub-interfaces configured on rac1/rac2 in the maintenance window, then the initial backup would start right after, keeping the shipment timeline. Prajeet noted Rubrik backup IPs do not need to be registered with Clusterware.

Igor added project objectives to epic IOSP-471 after confirming with Calvin and Aylin (old Confluence page review; Postgres onboarding to Rubrik is among the objectives). Earle clarified he meant SASP 'Recover' (restore using Rubrik as source), not backup; Calvin translated and Earle agreed.

Status ON-TRACK. Completed: IOSP-1011 (Earle), IOSP-1014 (Calvin). Timeline in email: IOSP-1012 10/16 18:00 UTC enable RAC backup (owner shown as Sri); IOSP-880 10/17-10/20; IOSP-1013 10/21 (Sri, Calvin); IOSP-1010 10/21-TBD shipment plan and contracts (Karl/Calvin, procurement); IOSP-1015 Oct 27-Nov 9 shipment; IOSP-1009 Oct 23-Nov 23 background DBA work (Earle); IOSP-1004/1005 Nov 9-16 rack/cable/power-up (Manchester team, Priya/Mena); IOSP-1006 Nov 16-Dec 6 commissioning (Calvin, Sri); IOSP-1007 Nov 30-Dec 6 production testing; IOSP-1008 Dec 7 fully production in Europe.

Calvin (in a separate maintenance-window chat): the VLAN change must complete within the maintenance window or it pushes back Rubrik timelines; Martijn Katerbarg approved but raised that IP usage is not officially tracked. Prajeet shared a Rubrik backup Wallet item for SASP Production RAC databases.

Calvin: the standalone Oracle in Secaucus is alive only for the Rubrik POC, so it can be decommissioned no later than the first week of November, possibly the last week of October (not formally part of the Rubrik project).
Igor asked Sri (1:1) to be added as optional to next week's call with the Network team on preparing Manchester for Rubrik.
